Perform pure-move extractions for the session-pane keyboard-intent producer and message-stack key-target semantics, move the new ownership/bounded-history scenarios into focused test modules using shared harness helpers, and keep behavior unchanged.
acceptance: SessionPaneView.scroll.ts and App.scroll-behavior.test.tsx shrink below their current thresholds; the keyboard-intent producer and key-target semantics each have a clear owns/does-not-own header and focused tests; the move-only commits preserve the complete UI test/build result.
